tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen and page background behind panels (the iOS grouped background role). From Footage Review Board's plane.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, list rows, sheets. Paper System bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, neutral badge fills, thumbnail placeholders. Never a text ground for soft text smaller than 13px.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface and surface-sunk (11:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units, timestamps on ground, surface and surface-sunk (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (unselected pills, inputs, hollow badges) on surface and ground (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The one accent. Only on things you act with: primary buttons, selected pills, the active tab, links. Text on ground and surface. Shared by Paper System and Claude Spinner.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay fill (5.2:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: clay-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind clay-ink text: tinted badges, the selected row wash.

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Clay text on clay-wash (5.4:1 both themes).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Attention, "needs you" and the focus ring. Deliberately a different hue from clay so busy (clay) and waiting-on-you (signal) never read alike. From Claude Spinner's attention blue, darkened for light-theme text.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind signal text (4.7:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: done, healthy, synced. Always paired with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: needs a look soon, stale, partial. Text on ground and surface (6.6:1 or better). Olive rather than amber so it stays 1.4:1 away from clay in lightness: an amber warn read as clay (1.06:1). Taken from Artifact Kit.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn-ink text: flags and warning tiles.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warn text on warn-wash (6.0:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Status: failed, over limit, destructive. Never used for a high value on a data scale. The dark value is a true red, 1.45:1 away from clay in lightness; the old coral read as clay (1.01:1). Taken from Artifact Kit.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind bad text (4.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Data scale, lowest step (calm, low urgency, slow bite). Marks only, 3:1 on surface. Claude Spinner's urgency ramp, darkened for light.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Data scale, second step. Marks only.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Data scale, third step. Marks only.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Data scale, top step (hottest, prime, most urgent). A scale value, not an error: pair with the scale's legend, never with an error message.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, Apple mint. First, and the colour of a single-series chart: blue is taken by signal, so a lone blue series would read as "needs you". Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, Apple purple. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, Apple blue. Never on a chart that also shows signal. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, Apple pink. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, Apple orange. Last on purpose: it sits 1.15:1 from clay, so never beside a clay control. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: chart-base
tokens.usage: Emphasis charts: every mark that is not the point, beside one series colour. 1.7:1 light, 2.3:1 dark, so these marks always carry a value label or sit beside a table. Never for a series of its own.

tokens.name: hl-purple
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in purple, as in Apple Notes: bold ink on hl-purple-wash (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hl-purple-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind hl-purple text: the system purple at 16% (light) or 24% (dark) over surface.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in pink, as in Apple Notes: bold ink on hl-pink-wash (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hl-pink-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind hl-pink text: the system pink at 16% (light) or 24% (dark) over surface.

tokens.name: hl-orange
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in orange, as in Apple Notes: bold ink on hl-orange-wash (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hl-orange-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind hl-orange text: the system orange at 16% (light) or 24% (dark) over surface.

tokens.name: hl-mint
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in mint, as in Apple Notes: bold ink on hl-mint-wash (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hl-mint-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind hl-mint text: the system mint at 16% (light) or 24% (dark) over surface.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in blue, as in Apple Notes: bold ink on hl-blue-wash (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hl-blue-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind hl-blue text: the system blue at 16% (light) or 24% (dark) over surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Toast and hint backgrounds over content, with white text. From WA Fish Map's hint.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: a hero number or a page headline. SF Pro Display everywhere (Instrument Sans off Apple devices).

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: A single big figure the screen exists for. Pair with a caption unit in ink-soft.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text on Apple. Web pages may drop to callout.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Filter by camera, lens or date.
styles.usage: Web body copy and denser app text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axes, footers. Smallest size for sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase key above a value: stat tiles, table headers, badges. Always uppercase, never a sentence.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Tabular figure in a stat tile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-glyph nudges, hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and flags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and chips; row inset (Footage Library row).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pill side padding; gap inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; minimum page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen edge inset on iPad and desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for anything tappable (Apple HIG).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, badges, flags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, stat tiles, segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, sheets, map chrome (WA Fish Map).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills, chips, toasts.

shadow.note: Almost none. Separate with surface against ground and hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The active segment in a segmented control only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things floating over content: popovers, scrub previews, toasts.
